About

Learning each day, and living with joy and happiness

artist, consultant, cyclist, designer, musician, photographer, world traveller

I live in Sydney, and love cycling, photography, music, and travel (not necessarily in that order). Lately I have been learning how to design and code.

This website is written in Astro based on the Cara theme by LekoArts. The source code for this website is available on Github and it is hosted on Vercel.

The websites featured on this page have been written in a mixture of React, NextJS and Wordpress (using my own Genesis child themes).

I am available for work should you wish to hire me.
